lines.text: Fans spotted a police ankle tag on Lucia in the GTA 6 trailer, and it could change how you play.
Lucia is one of the two leads, alongside Jason, and Rockstar showed her leaving prison.
Several outlets noticed an ankle monitor on her leg.
Fans think it could mean she is on probation.
Which might mean she can't roam the whole map at the start.
Others think the trailer tells her story in reverse.
But Rockstar has not explained it, so all of this is just theory.
Either way, it is a detail worth watching for in the game.
